title: 第2304章 打听大玄界营地的消息第2303章 虎宋
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
这让一众妖族看得惊呆了。
在他们眼中，无法匹敌的敌人，在江尘的面前，只是手一挥，就灰飞烟灭了。
这是何等强大的实力啊？
虎宋很快就回过神来，连忙向江尘跪下：“我是虎族的虎宋，谢谢前辈出手相助。”
虎宋此时内心也是很忐忑。
不知道江尘的心里是怎么想的。
毕竟人族与妖族在外相遇，极易发生冲突。
虽然说现在圣域的各族联合起来，但是现在没有其他人，江尘这么强大，如果真是有什么歹心的话，那么他们这些人小命休矣。
“嗯，现在你们这边的情况如何？我是南部区域的人，收到你们中部区域联军的求援，前来支援中部区域的。”江尘开口道。
“你是南部区域的人？”虎宋吃了一惊。
虎宋是妖族，虽然实力也算不错了，但是并不清楚南部区域的情况。
“没错，如果附近有异域的敌人，我可以解决再前往中部区域，你先跟我说一说这周围的情况吧，能帮的，我肯定会帮忙解决。”江尘开口道。
“大人大恩，我们现在无尽森林不少地方都受到入侵，我们妖族大军，节节败退，完全不是对手，如果不是靠着这片无尽森林，我们的地盘早就被异域强者占领了，不过，现在形势也不容易乐观，据说，这一次由不少大乘境强者带队，入侵我们这片区域，我们的妖族强者们，也没有办法，现在处境十分不妙，下令让我们各自带着妖族撤退。”虎宋道。
像虎宋这样的妖族队伍，其实不少，都是为了撤离这片区域，不被异域强者杀死。
但是这些异域强者派出不少队伍，前往对付这些妖族。
异域入侵者整体实力强大，妖族这边的处境十分被动。
“原来如此。”江尘点点头。
“你先安顿好你们这些人，然后你指路，我去灭了他们，我在这儿等你，相信，刚才那些异族强者已经将这儿的消息发送回去了，对方的大乘境强者很快就会过来。”江尘道。
“是，多谢大人，多谢大人。”虎宋连忙应道。
虎宋与江尘交换了信物，可以定位双方的位置。

虎宋先带着其他的妖族离开这儿，寻找一个安全的地方。
虎宋离开半个时辰后，三道流光朝江尘这边而来。
他们收到了韦姓修士等人的消息，前来支援的。
据说出现了一个大乘境级别的敌人，他们三人被派来支援，灭杀一个敌方的大乘境强者，这可是大功一件。
派三位前来，这也是为了保险起见。
一个大乘境五重，两个大乘境三重，均是大玄界的强者。
江尘就在这儿等着这三人的到来。
这三个人来到这儿之后，发现只有江尘一个人在这儿，周围都是大玄界修士的残尸。
此时，江尘的气息内敛，对方一时之间无法感应到江尘的具体修为。
但是能知晓，江尘是大乘境界级别的强者。
“这些人都是你杀的？”为首的大乘境五重强者沉声道，双眼满是怒火。
其他两名大乘境三重的强者，此时已经将江尘其他方向给堵住了，而且，还动用了的手段，封锁了周围的空间，不让使用空间手段。
“没错，这些人都是我杀的，我等你们前来已经等了许久了，你们来得有点慢啊。”江尘淡淡地道。
content_en:
This shocked all the demon clans.
In their eyes, the unmatched enemy was wiped out in front of Jiang Chen with just a wave of his hand.
How powerful is this?
Hu Song quickly came to his senses and quickly knelt down to Jiang Chen: "I am Hu Song from the Tiger Clan. Thank you for your help, senior."
Hu Song was also very worried at this time.
I don’t know what Jiang Chen is thinking in his heart.
After all, when humans and monsters meet outside, it is very easy for them to conflict.
Although all the tribes in the Holy Domain are now united, there is no one else as powerful as Jiang Chen. If he really has any evil intentions, then their lives will be at stake.
"Well, how is the situation here now? I am from the southern region. I received a request for help from your central region coalition forces and came to support the central region." Jiang Chen said.
"Are you from the southern region?" Hu Song was surprised.
Hu Song is a demon clan. Although his strength is pretty good, he doesn't know the situation in the southern region.
"Yes, if there are enemies from foreign lands nearby, I can deal with them before heading to the central area. Please tell me about the surrounding situation first. If I can help, I will definitely help solve them," Jiang Chen said.
"Your Majesty, many places in the Endless Forest are being invaded. Our monster army is retreating steadily. We are no match for it. If it weren't for this Endless Forest, our territory would have been occupied by foreign warriors. However, the current situation is not easy to be optimistic. It is said that this time many powerful Mahayana warriors will invade our area. Our monster warriors have no choice. The current situation is very unfavorable, and we have been ordered to retreat with the monster clan." Hu Song said.
There were actually quite a few demon clan teams like Hu Song, all in order to evacuate this area and avoid being killed by strong men from foreign lands.
But these foreign powerful men sent many teams to deal with these monsters.
The alien invaders are overall powerful, and the demon tribe is in a very passive situation.
"That's it." Jiang Chen nodded.
"You settle down you people first, and then you show the way. I will go and destroy them. I will wait for you here. I believe that the powerful foreigners have sent back the news here just now, and the powerful Mahayana realm experts from the other side will come here soon," Jiang Chen said.
"Yes, thank you sir, thank you sir." Hu Song responded quickly.
Hu Song and Jiang Chen exchanged tokens, which allowed them to locate the locations of both parties.
Hu Song took the other demon clan away from here first, looking for a safe place.
Half an hour after Hu Song left, three streams of light came towards Jiang Chen.
They received news from the monk surnamed Wei and others and came to support them.
It was said that an enemy at the Mahayana level had appeared, and the three of them were sent to support them. Killing an enemy Mahayana strongman was a great achievement.
We sent three people here just to be on the safe side.
One is at the fifth level of the Mahayana realm, and two are at the third level of the Mahayana realm. They are both strong men in the Great Mysterious Realm.
Jiang Chen was waiting here for the arrival of these three people.
After these three people arrived here, they found that Jiang Chen was the only one here, surrounded by the corpses of monks from the Great Mysterious Realm.
At this time, Jiang Chen's aura was restrained, and the other party could not sense Jiang Chen's specific cultivation level for a while.
But it is known that Jiang Chen is a powerful person at the Mahayana realm.
"Did you kill all these people?" The leader of the fifth-level Mahayana realm master said solemnly, his eyes full of anger.
The other two powerful men at the third level of the Mahayana Realm had already blocked Jiang Chen's other directions at this time. Moreover, they also used special means to block the surrounding space and prevent the use of spatial means.
"Yes, I killed these people. I have been waiting for you to come for a long time. You are a bit slow to come." Jiang Chen said calmly.
